name: The Battle Is The Lords
overview: Scripture reveals that the battle belongs to the Lord, who fights on behalf of His people with sovereign power and authority. In Exodus, Moses encourages Israel to stand firm and trust in God's salvation, for the Lord Himself will fight their enemies and bring deliverance. The Lord is described as a warrior, emphasizing His might and commitment to protect His people, as seen in Deuteronomy where God goes with His people to save them. Ultimately, victory is not achieved by human strength or power but by the Spirit of the Lord, who shapes and sustains His people as the Potter shapes the clay.
